title: 1 BDR Loft close to Vanderbilt Hospital
description:
✔️ Minutes from Centennial Park, Vanderbilt, and downtown Nashville
✔️ Stylish city-view condo with modern comforts
✔️ Walk to dining, shopping, and local attractions
✔️ Sleeps 4 with 1 bedroom and sleeper sofa + 1 bathroom
✔️ Relaxed home base for exploring Music City

The space
• Modern second-floor condo with bright, open living spaces
• Comfortable living room with Smart TV and dedicated workspace
• Fully equipped kitchen with stone countertops and counter seating
• King bedroom with ensuite bath and Smart TV
• Private washer & dryer and elevator access (when available)

🌅 Indoor & Outdoor Living
• Bright open-concept living area
• City views
• Smart TV in living room
• Dedicated workspace with high-speed Wi-Fi
• Elevator access to second-floor unit

🛏️ Bedrooms & Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 4)
• This home includes 1 bedroom and 1 bathroom.
• Bedroom 1 — King bed; Smart TV; ensuite bathroom
• Living Room — Full-size sleeper sofa (sleeps 2)
• Bath — Tub/shower combo with single vanity

🍳 Kitchen & Dining
• Full kitchen with stainless steel appliances
• Stone countertops
• Counter seating for casual dining
• Cookware, dinnerware & utensils provided
• Salt, pepper, and cooking oil are not provided

🏖️ What's Included
• Private in-unit washer & dryer
• High-speed Wi-Fi
• Smart TVs in living room and bedroom
• Bedding, towels & starter essentials provided

📍 Location Highlights
• West End neighborhood near Centennial Park
• Minutes to Vanderbilt University
• Short drive to The Gulch & Broadway
• Close to restaurants, cafés & shopping

🚗 Parking, Safety & Notes
• Parking: One vehicle per unit is allowed under the building on a first-come, first-served basis. Additional vehicles may be parked on the street where available.
• Floor/Elevator: This home is on the 2nd floor. There is an elevator in the building; it’s operated and maintained by the building management and may be unavailable due to maintenance or outages. Stairs are required if the elevator is unavailable.
• Pet policy: This home is not pet friendly. An additional cleaning fee may apply if evidence of a pet is found.
• Check in is at 4:00 PM and checkout is at 10:00 AM.
